name: labs/natlabrockies__multi-tube-od-reader
title: Multi-Tube-OD-Reader (my_app.classes.device.Device)
intro: Multi-Tube-OD-Reader (my_app.classes.device.Device), adapted from natlabrockies/multi-tube-od-reader. It reads `serial_number`, `port_positions` and `port_usage`; sets `name`; runs `measure_voltage` and `blink`. `measure_voltage`: measure a DC or RMS voltage on a declared channel or terminal pair and return the value with its sampling timestamp and measurement range. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
